type Repeat<T> = T extends [infer U, U] ? U : never;
type Pair<T> = T extends { a: infer U; b: U } ? U : never;
type Ordered<T> = T extends [infer U, infer V extends U] ? V : never;
type Templated<T> = T extends [infer U extends string, infer V extends `${U}!`] ? V : never;
type Else<T> = T extends [infer U] ? never : U;
type Own<T> = T extends infer U extends { self?: U } ? U : never;
type Outer<T, U> = T extends [infer U, U] ? U : never;
const outer: Outer<[1, string], string> = 1;
console.log(outer);
